payload.body: NOW - Trump says Xi is tall for a Chinese man: "He's central casting. You wouldn't, you couldn't find a guy like him. Even his, his physical features, you know, he's tall, very tall, and especially for this country, because they tend to be a little bit shorter." @disclosetv
